current.valueOrDefault: process.env.PATH captured at constructor; undefined remains undefined
current.precedence: entrypoint generates/export KUBECONFIG at /run/kubeclaw-buster/config/kubeconfig; kubelet-injected SERVICE_HOST/PORT populate that kubeconfig. Native parent and setpriv child inherit process.env; constructor shallow-copies these four values once. Files at captured path are not content-frozen. No implicit Ops MCP credentials alias.

records.typeUnitDomain: Current optional ambient ENV string/no strict local parser; PATH only controls child executable/plugin resolution, while actual kubectl is fs.realpathSync-selected file. KUBECONFIG may otherwise be multi-file path list through native client-go; SERVICE_HOST/PORT drive fallback/in-cluster selection and entrypoint server generation. Target generated four-field declaration rejects undeclared ambient authority, multi-kubeconfig lists, kubeconfig exec/auth-provider/inline tokens/insecure-skip-TLS/plainHTTP/wrong current-context/unauthorized CA or token locators. Exact selected kubectl/image ABI, canonical fixed kubeconfig path and single same-cluster service binding required. Kubelet IP/service port/ref are runtime declarations, not extra operator/task policies.

reader.operation: constructor copies PATH into #environment; #run→executeProcess→runProcessInput→spawn exact selected absolute kubectl with captured four-field ENV; selected client-go kubeconfig loader/transport resolves config and tokenFile
reader.capture: construction once; process env changes do not change existing #environment; referenced kubeconfig/CA/token files may mutate or rotate and kubectl is launched per operation

credentialRootVariableDistinction.separateProjection: BUSTER_V2_KUBERNETES_CREDENTIALS in Dockerfile/overlay is a different variable; equal paths do not prove reader or author alias
credentialRootVariableDistinction.target: one same captured provider/root binding must feed actual reader; old unused equal/different ENV rejected, no second taskintent

records.productiveCallerChain: actual overlay projected buster-api-token token/CA/downward namespace + readOnlymount→entrypoint fixed projected-root readability/namespace checks→generated single-context kubeconfig/tokenFile/CA and service-host/port→native-parent→root supervisor→setpriv uid1000 groups1000,1002→remote-plan-cli→production capability builder→TailscaleExposure constructor capture→prepare/release→kubectl. Original source-attestation/task/module identity is not replaced by credential transport.

target.credentialRotation: record credential provider/projection identity, issuer/subject/audience/policy+grant refs and immutable external revision where externalstore used; no bearer bytes/config token dump/hash. activationScope.current: ENV construction capture only; per kubectl file resolution means file mutation remains possible
activationScope.target: R captured injection declaration before module dispatch; S selected image/service process; cleanup/recovery must rehydrate originalModule runtimeRef/grant+credential declaration, not resolve B/Latest. Host/ABI/cluster retargeting is H maintenance, not ordinary policy tuning.
activationScope.runStable: A prepares lease with original cluster/grant/source/namespace/owner binding, B selects distinct next-module binding; A release operates only original lease/API subject and generation. Auth rotation stays within declared captured provider policy.

records.recoveryRetryClaimDeadlineBudgetEffects: prepare uses kubectl auth can-i get+patch on busternamespaceleases.<apiGroup> in controller namespace; verifies task lease/service/namespace/expiry and exposure owner/request; release compares owner and superseded is no-op, patch/readiness uses same captured env. Retained releaseAction includes owner-test patch but DOES NOT encode executable/credential/grant/module ref; target must accompany it with originalModule cleanup binding, not authorize raw releaseAction under Latest PATH/KUBECONFIG. Existing fixture readiness/envelope records bind module/attempt/claim/source, not complete credential injection declaration.
records.profileEvalSuitability: captured R/generated binding; no independent tuning axis. A/B differ selected nonproduction cluster/grant/runtime generation through declared fixture binding, not arbitrary authored ambient ENV. Eval pins original runtime/credential/grant refs and reader/image identities; unrelated injected credential or task field is rejected before dispatch.
records.migrationAction: C3 explicit existing runtime injection parameter replaces ambient constructor authority; capture four declared fields from existing runtime selection; preserve issuer/subject/grant and module/cleanup references, reject undeclared/equal/different ambient overrides. No new task intent, endpoint author, external Secret values, Ops MCP alias, or host action.
